g.text: D Coverage by dose; development / test pairs
EXP-008: fixed samples and availability of the old-map features
A: blue = nine peaks; tan = eighteen; gray = other labels. Open/crossed origins failed qualification.
B: gray halos exclude normalized distance ≤0.04 from 24 prior origins; blocks contain eligible pixels, not unseen rectangles.
C-D: all 3,456 candidate entries; outside-crop membership is unknown. Paired bars: development left, test right.
